study: Coconino B1 2019 independent external DTM validation

source.project: USGS AZ Coconino B1 2019 (Atlantic 19049; NGTOC task order 140G0219F0247)

checkpointSource: 19049 Project Report Tables 8 (NVA) & 9 (VVA), reprojected to Albers; the frozen 121-checkpoint table validation/terrain-field/references/coconino-b19-2019__checkpoints.json
independence: NVA/VVA checkpoints held separate from the 12 LiDAR Control Points; not used for calibration, registration, strip adjustment, classification tuning, or OLV parameter tuning.
matchRule: A checkpoint is IN the universe iff its Albers (E,N) falls inside a downloaded tile's header bounds. Membership frozen here, before any residual is computed. No checkpoint removed for a large error.

checkpointFunnel.note: The metrics below are computed over the 58 usable checkpoints. That is the evaluated subset, not the total checkpoint population. Per-checkpoint reasons: coconino-eligibility.json.

dtm.method: Production rasterizeDtm, point-in-cell mean over class-2 ground. Each checkpoint is compared to the cell containing it: nearest cell, no interpolation.

accuracyStatement.basis: USGS/NDEP-ASPRS vertical accuracy. NVA at the 95% confidence level (1.96 x RMSEz, errors approximately Gaussian on open ground); VVA at the 95th percentile, which by definition tolerates the top 5% of vegetated returns as a non-Gaussian tail.
accuracyStatement.percentileMethod: Linear interpolation between order statistics of |residual|, the same function the accuracy gate judges against.

limitations: 2 of 60 checkpoints (2 VVA) were rejected for carrying no classified ground in their 1 m DTM cell. Every rejection is VVA, and the rule that rejects them is the absence of a ground return, which is the condition the VVA class exists to test. The missingness is therefore informative: the VVA statistics are conditional on a ground return existing at the checkpoint, so they describe vegetated ground the bare-earth surface reached rather than vegetated ground in general.

The universe holds 57 of the 109 tiles the frozen checkpoint table requires, so it covers part of the project rather than all of it. Which tiles are required is a pure function of the checkpoint table and the tiling rule (required-tiles.json); no tile is selected by its result, and membership is fixed before any residual is computed.
Found third-party checkpoints, not a survey preregistered against an OLV protocol. This caps the determination below E5 regardless of sample size.

evidenceIndependence.note: NVA/VVA accuracy checkpoints held separate from the 12 LiDAR Control Points; the DTM was produced by the unchanged production terrain path with no reference to these checkpoints.

evidenceDetermination.achievedLevel: E3_SYNTHETICALLY_VALIDATED (unchanged); recorded as strong EXTERNAL CHECKPOINT AGREEMENT below the grade line
limitingReasons: PREREGISTRATION (verify-field-study F10): the USGS Coconino survey is 2019; an OLV protocol registers 2026, so registeredAt > fieldwork.startedAt. Found third-party checkpoints cannot satisfy the repo's E5 preregistration bar, which requires the checkpoint survey to be frozen against the protocol before fieldwork.
evidenceDetermination.conclusion: Frozen universe of 60 independent USGS checkpoints (38 NVA, 22 VVA) inside the downloaded tiles. F7 sample size met; E5 still blocked by F10 (found checkpoints cannot be preregistered). DTM stays E3 pending the tier decision. The residual metrics, and the usable subset they are computed over, are in coconino-metrics.json; per-checkpoint eligibility is in coconino-eligibility.json.
